tagline: We build things that outlast the brief.
audience: developers, public clients and private owners who want an architecture studio that designs, details and supervises buildings in honest materials
voice: direct, dry and craft-obsessed. Short declarative sentences, concrete numbers, no architect-speak and a little deadpan humour.
designNotes: Brutalist-flat design language recoloured to poured-concrete grey with an acid-lime accent, black frames, heavy grotesque headings and thick-frame capital buttons.
brandFacts: Northwind Architects, Havenstraat 12, 3011 Rotterdam. Phone +31 10 555 0183. studio@northwind.nl. Sample copy: names, fees and project details are examples to replace.
description: A complete six-page Divi 5 website for an architecture studio, interior designer, construction firm or any serious, material-led practice, ready to make your own. Home, Projects, The Studio, Services, Journal and Contact share one blunt, confident identity: poured-concrete grey, an acid-lime accent, black frames and heavy grotesque headings. Every section is built from proven, validated recipes and a single design language and style kit, so buttons, accordions, forms and type match on every page, on desktop, tablet and phone. A full-bleed image hero, a big-numbers band, a selected-work grid, a bento of services, a gallery wall, three in-depth project cases, a before-and-after of a transformed site, a partner team grid with a founder note, a fee comparison table, a materials comparison and a visit-the-studio page are all in place. Names, fees and project details are sample copy: swap in your own and publish. No lorem ipsum, no broken layouts. One simple commercial license, unlimited client sites.
